contract.detail: AI-reconstructed; native crop assembly then proportional export

capabilities.editor: built-in image_gen, two local reference inputs
capabilities.registration: bounded similarity using low-frequency luminance/gradient correspondence; no local warps
capabilities.blend: normalized overlap with confidence, exposure field and 20% feather

jobs.material: Wide Roadster event poster photograph. Preserve exact vehicle lineup, inverted flying car, smoke geometry, ramp and stage lighting. Preserve the ROADSTER title exactly; never invent lettering. Original colours: black background, metallic silver, warm title, red rails.

context.conversion: oriented RGB8 sRGB working copy; source untouched

attempts.prompt:
1=original: identity, geometry, color and light authority. 2=target: return exact crop/framing/geometry. Reconstruct plausible photographic detail; preserve original contours, imperfections and focus falloff. Optical clarity, natural edge transitions, spatially varied texture. Repair inherited compression artifacts. Avoid invented structures or marks, relighting, halos, ringing, embossed/crosshatched/repeated texture, synthetic grain and blanket sharpening.
Wide Roadster event poster photograph. Preserve exact vehicle lineup, inverted flying car, smoke geometry, ramp and stage lighting. Preserve the ROADSTER title exactly; never invent lettering. Original colours: black background, metallic silver, warm title, red rails.
Rigid objects: preserve silhouette, proportions and existing hardware. Do not invent fins, panel seams, rivets, spokes or lattice members. Keep repeating structures aligned. Smoke: preserve exact irregular lobes, soft fringes, palette and volume; no uniformly sharp surfaces. Black empty areas must remain quiet, with no stars, patterns, added objects or invented detail. Bright clipped lights stay soft.
Return only image 2, the target crop, matching its entire framing and aspect ratio (820:461), without borders, reframing or returning the full scene. Image 1 is the complete original supplied as context. Use maximum practical supported native resolution. Enhance the existing image only.
attempts.requestedSize: maximum practical native resolution; target aspect
